title: Keep multidimensional efficiency dimensions observable
narrative: Nubble needs tool calls, tokens, latency, and coordination cost kept as separate efficiency dimensions rather than a single opaque proxy. Accepts FineEnvs tool-call efficiency observations[^fineenvs-efficiency].
implementation: `EfficiencyScorecard` and `build_efficiency_scorecard` in `mechaharness.efficiency_scorecard` compose topology/cost/coordination/resume dimensions without silent collapse.
validation: Kind `efficiency_scorecard_build`. Soft expects tool_calls and tokens_out dimensions. Unit tests in `tests/test_efficiency_scorecard.py`.

footnotes.label: FineEnvs multi-harness RL — tool calls and tokens
